Resolves #18802

🌿 *The engine already knew. Once the mount stops answering for a render it never saw, "I awaited `promiseUpdate()`, so my change is on screen" loses the footnote it has carried since the beginning — and the bookkeeping that footnote seemed to require turns out to be unwritable, because there was never anything to write down.*

**Vdom updates are LOCKED before the first render.** `updateVdom()` parks every one of them while `!vnodeInitialized` ([`VdomLifecycle.mjs:1133`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs#L1133)), and `afterSetVnodeInitialized` drains what parked once the render lands ([`:147`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs#L147)). `component.Abstract#afterSetMounted` claimed and settled **every** parked promise anyway, which pre-empts that drain: a `promiseUpdate()` asked for after the mounting render collected settled against the tree that render carried — `pristine`, handed to a caller about to focus or measure what it just changed.

The mount now claims only when nothing is queued. `needsVdomUpdate` is the engine's own record that a cycle is coming, so the render that carries the change is the one that settles it.

```js
!me.needsVdomUpdate && VDomUpdate.claimPromiseCallbacks(me.id);
```

Evidence: L2 (unit runtime, spawned Playwright workers — the contract is App-Worker promise timing, fully reachable there) → L2 required. Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: one-line behavioral change — the diff is that line plus its comment and one spec arm.

## Deltas from ticket

**The ticket's prescribed mechanism is not what shipped, and the difference is the whole review.**

#18802 prescribes that a render record which components its payload expands — an `expandedIds` Set filled by `TreeBuilder#buildTree` and claimed by `initVnode` and `getVdomUpdatePayload`. I built that first. It was four files, a new `VDomUpdate` API, and a side-channel output parameter threaded through the recursive tree builder — whose expansion decisions exist to keep payloads light, not to report on themselves. It also cost a `vnode` accessor per reference on a full-tree build (`9.2µs` → `10.6µs` per payload over 20 children), because both expansion tests short-circuit before that read when `depth === -1`, so I had to add a second guard to buy the cost back.

@tobiu challenged it on exactly that ground, and the challenge holds: the engine should not be made to track this. It already knows. **Updates are locked before the first render, so a request made after that render collected always has its own cycle coming — and `needsVdomUpdate` is where the engine records that.** There is no expansion set to compute, and nothing new to store. The tracking version and this one pass the identical eight arms; this one is `1` behavioral line against `~90` across four files.

`promiseUpdate`'s JSDoc keeps its not-yet-mounted paragraph rather than dropping it as AC-5 asks: the exception the ticket wanted removed is gone in the case it describes, but the paragraph also states the lock, which is true and load-bearing. Rewriting it to say only the first half would lose the reason.

## Evolution

Opened with the ticket's `expandedIds` mechanism implemented as specified, including a measured perf regression and the guard added to offset it. Replaced wholesale after @tobiu's challenge: the payload-weight decisions inside `TreeBuilder` were being read as a proxy for a question the lifecycle already answers, and the proxy was the expensive part. What survived is one line, and the ACs did not move.

| #18802's prescribed `expandedIds` tracking | **red** |

Two unrelated mechanisms, one failure: removing the mount's claim is what breaks it, however the claim set is computed. Cause and blast radius are on the ticket — [#18802 comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/18802#issuecomment-5713225308). Short version: [`Workspace.mjs:2736`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs#L2736) awaits an **unmounted** host's `promiseUpdate()` as an await-mount primitive, which is the documented exception this ticket deletes, and there are ~70 call sites with eleven more on the same path in `dock/projection/Reconciler.mjs`.

Migrating that one consumer to `mountedPromise` turns everything green locally, but that is a contract change plus a consumer migration this ticket does not scope — so it is not in this diff. Held for @neo-opus-grace's ruling as the ticket's author; high-priority A2A sent. Not seeking review in this state.
